svg.title: A good night's sleep sharpens reaction time
svg.desc: Joint plot of a sleep study: a central scatter of mean reaction time (vertical, milliseconds, lower is better) against hours slept the night before (horizontal) for 120 volunteers, with a fitted trend line sloping downward — more sleep, faster responses. A green histogram along the top rail shows hours slept are roughly symmetric; a purple histogram along the right rail shows reaction time has a long slow upper tail. Illustrative data.
svg.text: A good night's sleep sharpens reaction time
Reaction-time test vs. hours slept, 120 volunteers — marginals show each distribution
Mean reaction time, ms (lower is better)
